title: 含理想变压器的级联二端口与输入阻抗
statement: 二端口 N 由三部分级联而成：串联电感 L = 4 mH、理想变压器 n = 2（2:1）、并联电阻 R = 2 Ω。端口 1 接 V̇_s = 20∠0° V（有效值），端口 2 接负载电容 C = 500 µF。ω = 1000 rad/s。
理想变压器（n:1）的 T 参数矩阵为 [n 0; 0 1/n]。先用级联求 N 的 T 参数。再求端接 C 时的输入阻抗 Z_in、负载电压的有效值 V_2，以及 R 吸收的功率。

questions.ask: 从 1–1' 向右看进去的输入阻抗 |Z_in| = ?

choiceExplain: 只算了串联电感的 j4 Ω，没有计入 C ∥ R 经变压器折算到原边（乘 n²）后的容性电抗。
只看到负载电容，忘了串联电感的 j4 Ω 也要加进 Z_in。
参数都已给定，用 T 参数（或逐级折算阻抗）就能算出 Z_in 的虚部，没有不确定的地方。
questions.explain: Z_in = 4 + j0 Ω：C 与 R 并联后为 1 − j1 Ω，经变压器折算到原边为 n²(1 − j1) = 4 − j4 Ω，正好与 L 的 j4 Ω 抵消。电源只输出有功功率。

questions.ask: 电阻 R 吸收的平均功率 P = ?
questions.explain: P = V_2²/R = 200/2 = 100 W。验算：I_1 = 20/4 = 5 A，电源输出 20 × 5 = 100 W；L、C、理想变压器都不消耗有功功率。

hints: 三个基本单元的 T 矩阵：串联阻抗 [1 Z; 0 1]，理想变压器 [n 0; 0 1/n]，并联导纳 [1 0; Y 1]。按从左到右的顺序相乘。
端接负载 Z_L 时（V̇_2 = −Z_L·İ_2）：Z_in = (A·Z_L + B)/(C·Z_L + D)，V̇_1 = (A + B/Z_L)·V̇_2。jωL = j4 Ω，Z_L = 1/(jωC) = −j2 Ω。
solution: **物理解释：** R ∥ C = 1 − j1 Ω，经 2:1 变压器折算到原边乘 n² = 4，得 4 − j4 Ω，与串联的 j4 Ω 相加正好是 4 Ω——两种方法结果一致。

en.title: Cascade with an ideal transformer and the input impedance
statement: Two-port N is a cascade of three parts: a series inductor L = 4 mH, an ideal transformer n = 2 (2:1) and a shunt resistor R = 2 Ω. Port 1 is driven by V̇_s = 20∠0° V (rms), and port 2 is loaded by a capacitor C = 500 µF. ω = 1000 rad/s.

The ABCD matrix of an ideal n:1 transformer is [n 0; 0 1/n]. First use the cascade rule to find the ABCD parameters of N. Then find the input impedance Z_in with C connected, the rms load voltage V_2 and the power absorbed by R.

questions.ask: Input impedance seen looking right into 1–1', |Z_in| = ?

choiceExplain: This counts only the series inductor's j4 Ω and leaves out the capacitive reactance of C ∥ R referred to the primary (times n²).
This sees only the load capacitor and forgets that the series inductor's j4 Ω also adds into Z_in.
Every value is given; the T parameters (or referring impedances stage by stage) give the imaginary part of Z_in, so nothing is undetermined.
questions.explain: Z_in = 4 + j0 Ω: C in parallel with R is 1 − j1 Ω; referred to the primary it becomes n²(1 − j1) = 4 − j4 Ω, which exactly cancels the j4 Ω of L. The source delivers only real power.

questions.ask: Average power absorbed by R, P = ?
questions.explain: P = V_2²/R = 200/2 = 100 W. Check: I_1 = 20/4 = 5 A and the source delivers 20 × 5 = 100 W; L, C and the ideal transformer absorb no real power.

hints: ABCD matrices of the three building blocks: series impedance [1 Z; 0 1], ideal transformer [n 0; 0 1/n], shunt admittance [1 0; Y 1]. Multiply them in order from left to right.
With a load Z_L (V̇_2 = −Z_L·İ_2): Z_in = (A·Z_L + B)/(C·Z_L + D) and V̇_1 = (A + B/Z_L)·V̇_2. jωL = j4 Ω, Z_L = 1/(jωC) = −j2 Ω.
solution: **5. Power.** P_R = V_2²/R = 200/2 = **100 W** = the source output V_1·I_1 = 100 W ✓.
**Physical picture:** R ∥ C = 1 − j1 Ω; referred through the 2:1 transformer it is multiplied by n² = 4, giving 4 − j4 Ω, and adding the series j4 Ω gives exactly 4 Ω — both methods agree.
